caption: One brief starts seven specialists. The reference becomes a produced reading workspace as contracts settle.
Interface, Data, and Accessibility run in parallel. Integration waits for all three accepted outputs.
The released product works: choose a book, filter thoughts, save a note, or add one locally.
Now corrupt one note identity. A real data contract rejects the candidate and holds the merge.
Inspect the duplicate-ID failure and its rejected candidate. Accepted Interface and Accessibility outputs survive.
Retry only Data with the valid fixture. The other specialists keep their original artifacts.
The accepted template, data, and labels now merge. Separate review must pass before Release can package them.
Six computed checks inspect the actual data and composed markup. Their receipt unlocks the local release.
Seven accepted outputs, an inspectable source bundle, and a working reading room. No live model calls or deployment.
